column3: Requests that started at or before the journal loss horizon (+16 ms slack) are left out and counted, with BootUI's LEFT_OUT_BEFORE_LOSS wording, in the check reason and the report limitations (RuntimeInsightsService.visibleEntries, leftOutBeforeLoss, v2.3.0; EvidenceRing.lost). Moved at v2.3.0 on eviction, discard and an event larger than the byte bound (EvidenceRing.add l.92-93); NOT moved for a paused journal or an unconfigured source, because v2.3.0 RuntimeJournal.offer returns false there without ring.lost (those lost() calls arrive after 2.3.0). Ported: an AI call whose owner is a left-out request is skipped without a count (visibleEntries l.815-823; ai-usage-by-route no longer reports it as 'joined no retained request'). Not ported: the aiCallsLeftOut count (a trace-linked AI call whose own start is before the loss; an AI event carries its end time only, so beforeLoss cannot be evaluated on its start) and errorLogsLeftOut (needs lostRequestEndMillis and lostRequestThreads, which the journal does not keep); executions other than http; the clear-time evictedRequestTraces. Each needs its own producer fact. The coverage and the window count the visible entries only (InsightsSnapshot.of builds both from them), and a trace-only event whose owner (resolved among all retained requests, as AiCallOwners does) is left out joins no judged request. Per-observation rows carry no left-out caveat, as at v2.3.0 (RuntimeInsightsService l.1042-1048 adds only unseen and partial to a row; l.1018-1021 adds the left-out sentence to the check reason).

DEFAULT TAKEN, owner may reverse: a request whose http record carries no start time is left out whenever the journal lost anything (fail closed). BootUI has no counterpart: RuntimeEvent.epochMillis is a primitive long that is always set.

DEFAULT TAKEN, owner may reverse: at METADATA_ONLY the request ids are withheld on read, so no request is projected and none can be counted as left out: the check answers the ids-withheld reason, never a clean result. BootUI has no counterpart: its journal keeps request ids whatever the exposure.

DEFAULT TAKEN, owner may reverse: RuntimeJournal.discard swaps the ring under the lock and walks the cleared events for the loss horizon outside it, under a second lock only reads wait on, so a clear of 50k events never stalls a producer. BootUI has no counterpart: EvidenceRing.lost runs inside a synchronized method.
